description: Source code for KafkaRDD class and related iterators in Spark Streaming Kafka integration, handling Kafka data consumption with offset management, caching, and partitioning.

classes.name: KafkaRDD
classes.description: A batch-oriented RDD for consuming Kafka data with offset control and partitioning.

classes.name: KafkaRDDIterator
classes.description: Iterator fetching Kafka messages for specified offsets, with optional caching.

classes.name: CompactedKafkaRDDIterator
classes.description: Iterator for Kafka topics with non-consecutive offsets, optimized for compacted data.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Returns partitions based on offset ranges.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts total messages, considering offset ranges or compacted data.

methods.name: countApprox
methods.description: Provides an approximate count of messages with confidence level.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the RDD is empty.

methods.name: take
methods.description: Retrieves a specified number of Kafka messages.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Creates an iterator over Kafka messages for a partition.
